legendTitle: The same symbols now refer to image-token rows
provenance: A fully inspectable one-head model uses 4×4 grayscale images and two-number rows. We work through its initial weights, then train all 44 parameters on the two pictured examples. LayerNorm and the feed-forward sublayer appear in the full ViT architecture after the numerical worksheet. Everything runs offline.
footer: Patch embeddings supply the rows; attention computes their contextual updates.
